szoveg_eredeti:
llama.cpp v1 is out 🔥 leading platform for local AI is now stronger and leaner than ever!

we’ll keep covering every platform and every model type, while keeping llama.cpp robust and lean for downstream applications that build on it.

we also lower the barrier of entry to use llama.cpp to few clicks by building Llama desktop apps. llama.cpp team and Hugging Face commit to democratize local AI to hundreds of millions.

many thanks for all the love you have shown to llama.cpp past years!

 https://lnkd.in/d9vp8W8Z 
check out desktop apps https://llama.app/
